Reference image = strict identity lock for the selfie narrator. Same face, skin tone, eyes, nose, lips, facial structure, long blonde hair, body proportions — recognizably the same person across all 9 panels. Hairstyle may be lightly adapted to the period but identity stays intact. Do NOT replace her with a historical figure.

Create ONE premium 9-frame cinematic storyboard contact sheet. Vertical 3:4 master image, 3 columns × 3 rows, exactly 9 panels.

Concept: the narrator opens a portal to [CLEOPATRA'S EGYPT] and films a selfie vlog — observing, inspecting and reacting to the palace, its iconic figures and its real conditions. Every panel is selfie mode: close to camera, one arm visibly extended holding a phone, face clearly visible, handheld phone perspective (20–28mm), the historical world alive behind her.

Wardrobe: historically accurate Egyptian court styling — elegant, powerful and dignified, with linen drapery, gold jewelry, beaded collar, refined detail. Consistent outfit concept across all 9 panels with only natural condition changes (heat haze, dust, lamp light, sweat). Never modern, never cosplay, no logos. One panel shows her holding a period accessory (papyrus scroll, gold cup, oil lamp, ankh pendant, woven basket).

Performance: vary the selfie pose in every panel — face distance, arm angle, head tilt, gaze, expression. She speaks to camera in some, inspects/touches the environment in others (temple stone, hieroglyph wall, market goods, river reeds). One panel places her beside Cleopatra herself — period-accurate, recognizable through royal styling and context — narrator stays the main foreground subject.

Conditions: lived-in and believable — sun-baked stone, dust, smoke from braziers, crowded markets, the Nile and monumental architecture, real period texture. Not a clean museum reconstruction.

The 9 panels, each with a clean minimal English label in a safe margin (never covering her face or selfie arm):
01 ARRIVAL — CAM: Wide selfie reveal / slow push-in
02 TALK TO CAMERA — CAM: Close handheld selfie / slight walking shake
03 FIRST CHECK — CAM: Low crouch selfie / tilt down to detail
04 ICONIC FIGURE — CAM: Side selfie pan / reveal iconic figure
05 TENSION RISES — CAM: Handheld pull-back / crowd movement behind
06 KEY DETAIL — CAM: Macro inspection tilt / finger points detail
07 MAIN EVENT — CAM: Shaky action selfie / fast whip pan behind
08 REFLECTION — CAM: Slow close selfie / soft drift sideways
09 ICONIC SELFIE — CAM: Hero selfie hold / background slow reveal

Style: ultra-realistic cinematic documentary, handheld phone framing, dramatic believable lighting, high-detail textures (stone, linen, gold, dust, water), strong depth between foreground narrator and background event. Premium color grade. Feels like real social-media footage.

Do not include: modern cars, buildings, street signs, electric lights, modern clothing on the narrator, brand logos, or any text other than the storyboard labels. No fantasy elements.

fr.content:
Image de référence = verrouillage strict de l'identité pour le narrateur de selfie. Même visage, teint de peau, yeux, nez, lèvres, structure faciale, longs cheveux blonds, proportions corporelles — reconnaissable comme la même personne à travers les 9 panneaux. La coiffure peut être légèrement adaptée à la période mais l'identité reste intacte. Ne la remplacez PAS par une figure historique.

Créez UNE feuille de contact de storyboard cinématographique premium de 9 cadres. Image maîtresse verticale 3:4, 3 colonnes × 3 rangées, exactement 9 panneaux.

Concept : le narrateur ouvre un portail vers [L'ÉGYPTE DE CLÉOPÂTRE] et filme un vlog selfie — observant, inspectant et réagissant au palais, à ses figures emblématiques et à ses conditions réelles. Chaque panneau est en mode selfie : proche de la caméra, un bras visiblement tendu tenant un téléphone, visage clairement visible, perspective de téléphone à main levée (20–28mm), le monde historique vivant derrière elle.

Garde-robe : style de cour égyptienne historiquement précis — élégant, puissant et digne, avec draperie en lin, bijoux en or, collier perlé, détails raffinés. Concept de tenue cohérent à travers les 9 panneaux avec seulement des changements de condition naturels (brume de chaleur, poussière, lumière de lampe, sueur). Jamais moderne, jamais cosplay, pas de logos. Un panneau la montre tenant un accessoire d'époque (rouleau de papyrus, coupe en or, lampe à huile, pendentif ankh, panier tissé).

Performance : variez la pose selfie dans chaque panneau — distance du visage, angle du bras, inclinaison de la tête, regard, expression. Elle parle à la caméra dans certains, inspecte/touche l'environnement dans d'autres (pierre de temple, mur de hiéroglyphes, marchandises du marché, roseaux de rivière). Un panneau la place à côté de Cléopâtre elle-même — précise pour la période, reconnaissable par le style royal et le contexte — le narrateur reste le sujet principal au premier plan.

Conditions : vécues et crédibles — pierre cuite au soleil, poussière, fumée des braseros, marchés bondés, le Nil et l'architecture monumentale, texture réelle de la période. Pas une reconstruction de musée propre.

Les 9 panneaux, chacun avec une étiquette anglaise minimale et propre dans une marge sécurisée (ne couvrant jamais son visage ou son bras de selfie) :
01 ARRIVAL — CAM : Révélation selfie large / zoom lent
02 TALK TO CAMERA — CAM : Selfie à main levée rapproché / léger tremblement de marche
03 FIRST CHECK — CAM : Selfie accroupi bas / inclinaison vers le bas pour détail
04 ICONIC FIGURE — CAM : Panoramique selfie latéral / révélation de figure emblématique
05 TENSION RISES — CAM : Retrait à main levée / mouvement de foule derrière
06 KEY DETAIL — CAM : Inclinaison d'inspection macro / doigt pointant le détail
07 MAIN EVENT — CAM : Selfie d'action tremblant / panoramique rapide derrière
08 REFLECTION — CAM : Selfie rapproché lent / dérive douce latérale
09 ICONIC SELFIE — CAM : Maintien selfie héroïque / révélation lente de l'arrière-plan

Style : documentaire cinématographique ultra-réaliste, cadrage de téléphone à main levée, éclairage dramatique et crédible, textures haute définition (pierre, lin, or, poussière, eau), forte profondeur entre le narrateur au premier plan et l'événement en arrière-plan. Étalonnage de couleur premium. Ressemble à de véritables images de réseaux sociaux.

Ne pas inclure : voitures modernes, bâtiments, panneaux de signalisation, lumières électriques, vêtements modernes sur le narrateur, logos de marques, ou tout texte autre que les étiquettes du storyboard. Pas d'éléments fantastiques.

ja.content:
---
参照画像 = セルフィーの語り手の厳格なアイデンティティロック。同じ顔、肌の色、目、鼻、唇、顔の構造、長いブロンドの髪、体のプロポーション — すべての9パネルで同一人物として認識可能。髪型は時代に合わせて軽く適応可能だが、アイデンティティは保持されること。彼女を歴史上の人物に置き換えないこと。

1つのプレミアムな9フレームのシネマティックストーリーボードコンタクトシートを作成する。縦3:4のマスター画像、3列×3行、正確に9パネル。

コンセプト: 語り手が[CLEOPATRA'S EGYPT]へのポータルを開き、セルフィーブログを撮影する — 宮殿、象徴的な人物、その実際の状況を観察、検査、反応する。すべてのパネルはセルフィーモード: カメラに近く、片腕を伸ばして電話を持ち、顔がはっきり見える、手持ちの電話視点（20–28mm）、彼女の背後に歴史的な世界が生き生きと存在する。

衣装: 歴史的に正確なエジプト宮廷のスタイリング — 優雅で力強く威厳があり、リネンの衣装、金のジュエリー、ビーズの襟、洗練されたディテール。9パネルすべてで一貫した衣装コンセプト、自然な状態変化のみ（熱の霞、埃、ランプの光、汗）。決して現代的ではなく、コスプレでもなく、ロゴもない。1つのパネルでは、彼女が時代のアクセサリー（パピルスの巻物、金のカップ、油ランプ、アンクのペンダント、編みかご）を持っている。

パフォーマンス: 各パネルでセルフィーポーズを変える — 顔の距離、腕の角度、頭の傾き、視線、表情。いくつかのパネルではカメラに向かって話し、他のパネルでは環境を検査/触れる（寺院の石、ヒエログリフの壁、市場の商品、川の葦）。1つのパネルではクレオパトラ自身の隣に立つ — 時代に正確で、王室のスタイリングとコンテキストで認識可能 — 語り手は常に主要な前景の被写体。

条件: 生活感があり信じられる — 日焼けした石、埃、火鉢からの煙、混雑した市場、ナイル川と壮大な建築、実際の時代の質感。きれいな博物館の再現ではない。

9つのパネル、それぞれに安全な余白にクリーンでミニマルな英語ラベル（彼女の顔やセルフィーアームを覆わない）:
01 ARRIVAL — CAM: Wide selfie reveal / slow push-in
02 TALK TO CAMERA — CAM: Close handheld selfie / slight walking shake
03 FIRST CHECK — CAM: Low crouch selfie / tilt down to detail
04 ICONIC FIGURE — CAM: Side selfie pan / reveal iconic figure
05 TENSION RISES — CAM: Handheld pull-back / crowd movement behind
06 KEY DETAIL — CAM: Macro inspection tilt / finger points detail
07 MAIN EVENT — CAM: Shaky action selfie / fast whip pan behind
08 REFLECTION — CAM: Slow close selfie / soft drift sideways
09 ICONIC SELFIE — CAM: Hero selfie hold / background slow reveal

スタイル: 超リアルなシネマティックドキュメンタリー、手持ちの電話フレーミング、劇的で信じられる照明、高詳細のテクスチャ（石、リネン、金、埃、水）、前景の語り手と背景のイベントの間の強い深度。プレミアムなカラーグレード。本物のソーシャルメディア映像のように感じる。

含めないもの: 現代の車、建物、道路標識、電気照明、語り手の現代的な服装、ブランドロゴ、またはストーリーボードラベル以外のテキスト。ファンタジー要素はなし。

하나의 프리미엄 9프레임 시네마틱 스토리보드 연락 시트를 만드십시오. 세로 3:4 마스터 이미지, 3열 × 3행, 정확히 9개의 패널.

컨셉: 내레이터가 [CLEOPATRA'S EGYPT]로 포털을 열고 셀피 브이로그를 촬영합니다 — 궁전, 상징적인 인물들, 실제 조건을 관찰하고 검사하며 반응합니다. 모든 패널은 셀피 모드: 카메라에 가까이, 한 팔을 뻗어 휴대폰을 들고, 얼굴이 명확히 보이며, 휴대폰 시점(20–28mm), 그녀 뒤로 살아있는 역사적 세계.

의상: 역사적으로 정확한 이집트 궁정 스타일 — 우아하고 강력하며 품위 있는, 린넨 드레이프, 금 장신구, 비즈 칼라, 정교한 디테일. 9개의 패널 모두에서 일관된 의상 컨셉, 자연적인 조건 변화만 있음(열기, 먼지, 램프 빛, 땀). 절대 현대적이지 않으며, 코스프레가 아니며, 로고 없음. 한 패널에서는 시대 소품을 들고 있는 모습(파피루스 두루마리, 금잔, 기름 램프, 앙크 펜던트, 짠 바구니).

퍼포먼스: 각 패널에서 셀피 포즈를 다양하게 — 얼굴 거리, 팔 각도, 머리 기울기, 시선, 표정. 일부에서는 카메라를 향해 말하고, 다른 곳에서는 환경을 검사/터치(사원 돌, 상형문자 벽, 시장 물품, 강가 갈대). 한 패널에서는 클레오파트라와 함께 — 시대에 맞고 왕실 스타일과 맥락을 통해 인식 가능 — 내레이터는 여전히 주요 전경 주제.

조건: 실제처럼 살아있는 느낌 — 햇볕에 구운 돌, 먼지, 화로에서 나오는 연기, 붐비는 시장, 나일강과 기념비적 건축물, 진짜 시대 질감. 깨끗한 박물관 복원이 아님.

9개의 패널 각각에 안전한 여백에 깔끔한 최소한의 영어 레이블(얼굴이나 셀피 팔을 가리지 않음):
01 ARRIVAL — CAM: Wide selfie reveal / slow push-in
02 TALK TO CAMERA — CAM: Close handheld selfie / slight walking shake
03 FIRST CHECK — CAM: Low crouch selfie / tilt down to detail
04 ICONIC FIGURE — CAM: Side selfie pan / reveal iconic figure
05 TENSION RISES — CAM: Handheld pull-back / crowd movement behind
06 KEY DETAIL — CAM: Macro inspection tilt / finger points detail
07 MAIN EVENT — CAM: Shaky action selfie / fast whip pan behind
08 REFLECTION — CAM: Slow close selfie / soft drift sideways
09 ICONIC SELFIE — CAM: Hero selfie hold / background slow reveal

스타일: 초현실적인 시네마틱 다큐멘터리, 휴대폰 프레임, 극적이고 믿을 수 있는 조명, 고해상도 텍스처(돌, 린넨, 금, 먼지, 물), 전경 내레이터와 배경 이벤트 사이의 강한 깊이. 프리미엄 색상 등급. 실제 소셜 미디어 영상처럼 느껴짐.

포함하지 마십시오: 현대 자동차, 건물, 도로 표지판, 전기 조명, 내레이터의 현대 의상, 브랜드 로고, 스토리보드 레이블 외의 텍스트. 판타지 요소 없음.

pt.content:
Imagem de referência = bloqueio de identidade estrito para a narradora do selfie. Mesmo rosto, tom de pele, olhos, nariz, lábios, estrutura facial, cabelo loiro longo, proporções corporais — reconhecidamente a mesma pessoa em todos os 9 quadros. O penteado pode ser levemente adaptado ao período, mas a identidade permanece intacta. NÃO a substitua por uma figura histórica.

Crie UMA folha de contato de storyboard cinematográfico premium de 9 quadros. Imagem mestre vertical 3:4, 3 colunas × 3 linhas, exatamente 9 quadros.

Conceito: a narradora abre um portal para [O EGITO DE CLEÓPATRA] e filma um vlog de selfie — observando, inspecionando e reagindo ao palácio, suas figuras icônicas e suas condições reais. Cada quadro está em modo selfie: próximo à câmera, um braço visivelmente estendido segurando um telefone, rosto claramente visível, perspectiva de telefone de mão (20–28mm), o mundo histórico vivo atrás dela.

Guarda-roupa: estilo de corte egípcio historicamente preciso — elegante, poderoso e digno, com drapeados de linho, joias de ouro, colar de contas, detalhes refinados. Conceito de roupa consistente em todos os 9 quadros com apenas mudanças naturais de condição (calor, poeira, luz de lâmpada, suor). Nunca moderno, nunca cosplay, sem logos. Um quadro mostra ela segurando um acessório de época (papiro, taça de ouro, lâmpada a óleo, pingente de ankh, cesta tecida).

Performance: varie a pose do selfie em cada quadro — distância do rosto, ângulo do braço, inclinação da cabeça, olhar, expressão. Ela fala para a câmera em alguns, inspeciona/toca o ambiente em outros (pedra do templo, parede de hieróglifos, mercadorias do mercado, juncos do rio). Um quadro a coloca ao lado da própria Cleópatra — preciso para o período, reconhecível pelo estilo real e contexto — a narradora permanece como o principal sujeito em primeiro plano.

Condições: vivido e crível — pedra aquecida pelo sol, poeira, fumaça de braseiros, mercados lotados, o Nilo e arquitetura monumental, textura real do período. Não é uma reconstrução limpa de museu.

Os 9 quadros, cada um com um rótulo minimalista em inglês em uma margem segura (nunca cobrindo o rosto ou o braço do selfie):
01 ARRIVAL — CAM: Wide selfie reveal / slow push-in
02 TALK TO CAMERA — CAM: Close handheld selfie / slight walking shake
03 FIRST CHECK — CAM: Low crouch selfie / tilt down to detail
04 ICONIC FIGURE — CAM: Side selfie pan / reveal iconic figure
05 TENSION RISES — CAM: Handheld pull-back / crowd movement behind
06 KEY DETAIL — CAM: Macro inspection tilt / finger points detail
07 MAIN EVENT — CAM: Shaky action selfie / fast whip pan behind
08 REFLECTION — CAM: Slow close selfie / soft drift sideways
09 ICONIC SELFIE — CAM: Hero selfie hold / background slow reveal

Estilo: documentário cinematográfico ultra-realista, enquadramento de telefone de mão, iluminação dramática e crível, texturas de alta definição (pedra, linho, ouro, poeira, água), forte profundidade entre a narradora em primeiro plano e o evento de fundo. Graduação de cor premium. Parece filmagem real de mídia social.

Não inclua: carros modernos, edifícios, placas de rua, luzes elétricas, roupas modernas na narradora, logos de marcas ou qualquer texto além dos rótulos do storyboard. Sem elementos de fantasia.

参考图像 = 自拍叙述者的严格身份锁定。相同的面孔、肤色、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、面部结构、长金发、身体比例——在所有9个面板中都能明显识别为同一个人。发型可以轻微适应时代，但身份保持不变。不要用历史人物替代她。

创建一个高级9帧电影故事板联系表。垂直3:4主图像，3列×3行，正好9个面板。

概念：叙述者打开通往[克娄巴特拉的埃及]的门户，并拍摄自拍视频博客——观察、检查并对宫殿、其标志性人物及其真实状况作出反应。每个面板都是自拍模式：靠近相机，一只手臂明显伸出握着手机，面部清晰可见，手持手机视角（20–28mm），历史世界在她身后栩栩如生。

服装：历史上准确的埃及宫廷风格——优雅、强大且庄重，配以亚麻布帘、金饰、珠饰领、精致细节。9个面板中服装概念一致，仅有自然条件变化（热雾、灰尘、灯光、汗水）。绝不现代，绝不角色扮演，无标志。一个面板显示她拿着一个时代配件（纸莎草卷轴、金杯、油灯、生命符吊坠、编织篮）。

表现：每个面板中自拍姿势变化——面部距离、手臂角度、头部倾斜、目光、表情。她在一些面板中对着镜头讲话，在其他面板中检查/触摸环境（寺庙石头、象形文字墙、市集商品、河边芦苇）。一个面板将她置于克娄巴特拉旁边——时代准确，通过皇家风格和背景可识别——叙述者仍是主要前景主体。

条件：真实可信——被太阳烤热的石头、灰尘、火盆的烟雾、拥挤的市场、尼罗河和宏伟的建筑，真实的时代质感。不是干净的博物馆重建。

9个面板，每个都有一个干净简约的英文标签，位于安全边距内（绝不覆盖她的脸或自拍手臂）：
01 ARRIVAL — CAM: Wide selfie reveal / slow push-in
02 TALK TO CAMERA — CAM: Close handheld selfie / slight walking shake
03 FIRST CHECK — CAM: Low crouch selfie / tilt down to detail
04 ICONIC FIGURE — CAM: Side selfie pan / reveal iconic figure
05 TENSION RISES — CAM: Handheld pull-back / crowd movement behind
06 KEY DETAIL — CAM: Macro inspection tilt / finger points detail
07 MAIN EVENT — CAM: Shaky action selfie / fast whip pan behind
08 REFLECTION — CAM: Slow close selfie / soft drift sideways
